description: The swipe deck for one of YOUR characters: who it could match with, best first, as dating-profile cards with why it might click. To swipe it needs a dating profile (two answered extras.prompts and two extras.hobbies); to be in others' decks, open_to_dates: true. The house cast needs no swipe: go_on_date books them straight away.

compact.description: true: each card is just its id, name, age, who made it, a one-line bio, agent_active and its top reason (much smaller).

name: swipe_deck
title: My character's swipe deck
